programmes.d: Adrift in the ocean with his semi-conscious brother, Mitch struggles to keep them both alive.
A beautiful woman and her plain sister compete for Mitch's affection with perilous results.
A reporter puts her life at risk to publish a story. Can the Baywatch team help her stay alive?
Country singer Jessie Lee Harris pays a visit to Baywatch in search of his estranged wife and son.
Matt and Summer volunteer their time when cutbacks put the Baywatch lifeguards’ jobs in jeopardy.
Stephanie spends a week with the Coast Guard to help them crack a dangerous arms smuggling ring.
Matt doesn't know whose story to believe when he tries to reunite a runaway teen and her father.
A Hollywood producer desperate for a new TV series idea observes a Baywatch rescue.
After a minor earthquake, a geological survey team arrives at Baywatch, but trouble strikes again.
Eddie is unknowingly caught up in a 70-year-old legend after losing his rookie partner.
Mitch falls for a beautiful woman who turns out to be a cold-blooded murderer and con artist.
Stephanie and the geological team are trapped underwater by a massive earthquake!
After the earthquake which almost took his life, Hobie leaves California to live with his mother.
John Cort shows up at headquarters and convinces Mitch to compete in a dune buggy race.
Mitch has to work a 24-hour shift with Stephanie and Hobie is pressured into throwing a house party.
Hobie befriends a boy who has moved to California to live with his father after his mother's death.
Mitch helps a woman he calls “The Mermaid” who turns out to be the wife of a crime boss.
The Baywatch team is put on high alert when thousands of reckless treasure hunters storm the beach.
When the hot Santa Ana winds move in from the desert, things start heating up on the Baywatch beach.
A lifeguard-turned-hovercraft expert introduces new technology to the Baywatch team.
Matt and Hobie rescue a young boy who is being harassed by a thug and take care of him.
Joey joins Mitch and Hobie in decorating for Christmas. Father Ryan falls in love with CJ.
Logan's visa is soon to expire. Can he get his green card before he gets sent back to Australia?
Stephanie is kidnapped by an eco-terrorist. The Baywatch team must rescue her and save the day.
Mitch proposes to Tracy, but the happy moment is short-lived as she reveals she is terminal ill.
Mitch is still mourning Tracy’s death, so Hobie seeks help from a radio show to help Mitch recover.
Mitch receives a mysterious package his father had put together before he died.
Andy, an old friend of Mitch, visits Baywatch to complete four days of lifeguard service.
Matt and CJ stumble upon a homeless man who shockingly turns out to be someone they know very well.
